turns.content: An electron travels at 1.00% of the speed of light. Using c = 2.998 × 10^8 m s^-1, state the de Broglie relation and calculate the speed.
Calculate the Lorentz factor and determine whether a nonrelativistic momentum calculation is adequate.
Calculate the momentum using m_e = 9.109 × 10^-31 kg.
Using h = 6.626 × 10^-34 J s, calculate the wavelength in metres.
Convert the wavelength to picometres and check the unit conversion.
Report the wavelength using 1 pm=1e-12 s, then predict it at twice the speed.
